description.en:
One fine day, Seha dies during a bungee jump, only to be reborn in "The Little Mermaid" as Princess Isabelle, a villain fated to be killed by the resentful Little Mermaid. 

To rewrite her fate, Isabelle seeks a different beau than the prince. This leads her to Grand Duke Waschke, who's the perfect husband material... if not for his curse, which claims the life of his bride on their wedding night. 

Will Isabelle find a way to break the curse and secure her happy ending? Or will she die a villain?
description.fr: Dans le conte de fées 'La Petite Sirène', existe Isabelle, une princesse d'un pays voisin qui a épousé le prince. Pourtant, la princesse, que l'on pensait être un simple second rôle, est une femme maléfique bien connue sur le continent Lorsqu'elle est ressuscité pour la 4ème fois, elle s'enfuit en rêvant d'un adieu à la petite sirène, mais d'autres héros de conte de fées se présentent à elle comme Blanche Neige ou l'homme se transformant en bête. «N'est-ce pas censé être l'histoire de la petite sirène? Je n'ai jamais vu un conte de fées comme celui-ci!» C'est un fait que la mort se répète quelle que soit l'histoire originale.
description.id: Aku merasuki Isabelle, putri dari negara tetangga yang menikah dengan Pangeran dalam dongeng “The Little Mermaid”. Namun, sang Putri, yang menurutnya hanya memainkan peran pendukung, ternyata adalah penjahat terkenal di benua itu. Apalagi meski dengan batas waktu hari kematiannya, dia tetap hidup. 'Apakah kamu bermain-main dengan orang lain? Tidak peduli bagaimana Tuhan itu ada, ini tidak benar.’ Ketika dia hidup kembali untuk keempat kalinya karena kehendak-Nya, dia melarikan diri, memimpikan perpisahan yang aman dengan Putri Duyung Kecil. Namun, Putri Salju dan Grand Duke yang berubah menjadi binatang muncul, dan jam yang muncul di setiap regresi adalah milik Hook. ‘Bukankah ini versi asli “The Little Mermaid”? Saya belum pernah melihat dongeng seperti ini!’ Apapun cerita aslinya, sudah menjadi fakta umum bahwa kematian berulang, dan setelah ini terjadi, dia membuat pernikahan kontrak dengan Grand Duke yang berubah menjadi binatang buas di malam hari untuk menjamin keselamatannya sampai…
description.ko:
동화 ‘인어공주’ 속 왕자와 결혼하는 이웃 나라 공주, 이자벨에 빙의했다.
그런데 단순한 조연인 줄 알았던 공주가 대륙에 소문이 자자한 악녀란다.
게다가 죽을 날을 받아둔 시한부인 것도 모자라 계속 살아난다.

‘사람 가지고 장난해? 아무리 신이 있다고 해도 이건 아니지.’

타의에 의해 네 번째로 살아났을 때,
인어공주와의 안전 이별을 꿈꾸며 도망쳤다.
하지만 스노우 화이트와 짐승으로 변하는 대공이 등장하고,
회귀 때마다 보이는 시계는 후크의 것이라는데-

‘이거 인어공주가 원작 아니었어? 이런 잡탕 동화는 본 적도 없다고!’

원작이 무엇이든 죽음이 반복되는 건 기정사실.
이렇게 된 거 죽을 날까지 안위를 보장받고자,
밤이면 짐승으로 변하는 대공과 계약 결혼을 했다.

그런데...... 이 남자, 좀 이상하다.

“공주는 이미 대공비가 아닙니까.”
“대공……비요?”
“그 사이 초야를 잊었습니까.”
description.ru:
Она очнулась как Изабель, будучи принцессой из соседнего королевства она вступила в брак с принцем из сказки «Русалочка»
Однако по её мнению она была лишь второстепенным персонажем, в то время как на всём континенте слагались легенды о её злодеяниях.
В последствии после нескольких смертей в уже привычный день, она так и не умерла.

«Жизнь человека для тебя шутка? Ты ведь даже не Бог»

Когда она вновь вернулась к жизни она сбежала от принца, мечтая распрощаться с судьбой «Русалочки»

Однако на её пути встречаются Белоснежка и Эрцгерцог превращающийся в Зверя.

“Разве я попала не в сказку про Русалочку?» Такой мешанины из сказок я еще не встречала.

Независимо от сюжета, смерть всегда настигала её. Заключив брачный договор с Эрцгерцогом, который превращается в зверя по ночам, череда её смертей внезапно прекратилась.

Он… немного странный…

«Разве вы уже не великая герцогиня?»
«Великая герцогиня…»
«Вы уже забыли, что у нас была первая брачная ночь?..»

description.en:
In spring, as cherry blossoms drift in the air, Chan-young, a 20-year-old repeat student, has his earphones hooked to the zipper of a 27-year-old postal clerk, Mi-sun.

In summer, as trees offer shade, a charming male doctor, Jun-sung, plays cupid to Min-hee and Gangi, a pair of seemingly longtime lovers.

In autumn, as red maple leaves decorate the blue sky, Gyeongtae, Jeongmi's ex-boyfriend, a web comic writer, suddenly appears at her doorstep. He's back.

In winter, as heavy snow blanckets the earth, Soo-heon, the chef of Gom Restaurant, meets a young woman in a rural guesthouse in Gangwon-do during a snowy day...

___
• [Official Indonesian](https://kakaopage.co.id/content/Ada-Banyak-Cinta/2746)

Bong Soo-Ah has not moved on from her fiancee's death, leading her to a stagnant path. On a drunken night with a friend, she meets an actor named Han Ji-Hyuk, whom she talks to all night. Since that fateful encounter, something clicked for Soo-Ah and made her act, all thanks to Ji-Hyuk
My son was bullied by his classmates until he couldn't take it anymore... This is the story of my revenge against them all...!

Attilan, a peaceful empire.  
The only son of the Keanos family, Nox enters the emperor's first concubine.  
Knox is settled in the court, but this time, the knights of the knights directly under the emperor keep approaching Knox…!  
Could Knox avoid these unpleasant approaches? And the secret behind Knox…?
Chuunibyou syndrome, ill bishounen, BJ… With all these attention seeking concepts, who's the biggest attention whore in this area?

“나에게…… 얼마까지 줄 수 있어요?”  
세상사 원래 사는 것이 힘들다고는 하지만 이렇게 힘들 줄은 몰랐다.   
돈이 없다는 이유 하나만으로 자신을 무시하는 세상에 지친 지나는 저승사자인 소휘가 내민 손을 차마 거절하지 못하고 덥석 잡고 말았다.  
그렇게 시작된 저승사자와의 기묘한 인연. 그와 함께 여러 귀(鬼)들을 만나면서 지나는 그 누구도 경험하지 못한 특별한 일을 경험하게 되는데…….

"I killed someone today."
Hyunwoo makes a living busking in subway stations. Turns out being blind makes people a lot more generous — and a lot more confiding. But when a strange man approaches him with a secret of his own, Hyunwoo is suddenly entangled in a murder case, turning his life upside down.

Sera and Heeju are identical twins, but no one confuses the two. Sera is beautiful, bright, and charming, while Heeju is dirty, smells bad, and has no charm at all. Heeju became this way due to the abuse and discrimination she suffered from her mother since childhood. Because of that, Heeju's soul gradually withered, and she got used to the idea that "it's all your fault" for being so insignificant. Until one day, when Heeju, after accidentally finding a lost dog, gets closer to Grandma Myungja. Thanks to Grandma Myungja, who sees her without prejudice, Heeju begins to experience a new phase in her life...
description.pt-br: Sera e Heeju são gêmeas idênticas, mas ninguém confunde as duas. Sera é bonita, brilhante e encantadora, mas Heeju é suja, cheira mal e não tem graça nenhuma. Heeju ficou assim por causa do abuso e da discriminação que sofreu da mãe desde pequena. Por causa disso, a alma de Heeju foi secando aos poucos, e ela acabou se acostumando com a ideia de que "a culpa é toda sua" por ser tão insignificante. Até que, um dia, Heeju, ao encontrar por acaso um cachorro perdido, se aproxima da vovó Myungja, e, graças à vovó Myungja, que a vê sem preconceitos, Heeju começa a viver uma nova fase em sua vida...

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 乙一

**Real Name:** Adachi Hirotaka (安達寛高)

Writer, screenwriter, and film director. Born October 21, 1978, in Tanushimaru (now part of Kurume), Fukuoka Prefecture. He graduated from Tanushimaru's Kawakai Primary and Secondary Schools.

A multifaceted and shy artist, Adachi Hirotaka has a love of video games, manga, anime, and movies. As a teenager, he was overweight and bullied at school, but through Dance Dance Revolution and a proper diet, he lost 20 kilograms, going from 85 to 65 kg.

Inspired by his early reading, particularly mystery novels, he began writing his first novel at 16 while attending Kurume National College from 1994 to 1999. He attempted to enter the Fujimi Prize for Novel with a fantasy novel, but was unsuccessful. In 1996, however, he won the 6th JUMP Novel Grand Prize from Shueisha, making his debut with Natsu to Hanabi to Watashi no Shitai (Summer, Fireworks, and My Corpse), published by JUMP j-BOOKS and illustrated by Hataji Hideaki. Judge Kurimoto Kaoru strongly recommended the work. He later transferred to Toyohashi University of Technology, where he studied ecological engineering.

In 2003, he placed third in the Honkaku Mystery Awards. His early work focused largely on short stories and light novels, of which he became a strong advocate. GOTH: Tenohira Jiken was particularly well received and won the Honkaku Mystery Award. His early fiction was broadly divided into horror novels ("Kuro Otsuichi") and sad stories ("Shiro Otsuichi"). Under the name Otsuichi, he has mainly published with Shueisha, Kadokawa Shoten (now KADOKAWA), and Gentosha.

In 2004, his editor invited him to audition for Oshii Mamoru's film Innocence. There he met Oshii Tomoe, the director's daughter, whom he married in 2006.

Adachi Hirotaka has also written under several pseudonyms. In 2005, he published ghost stories under the name Yamashiro Asako in Media Factory's magazine Yu. He also wrote romance fiction as Nakata Eiichi for a Shodensha romance anthology and the magazine Feel Love. He deliberately fabricated biographical information for these identities, but revealed on Twitter on June 30, 2011, that he had been working under both names.

In November 2012, the Mainichi Shimbun reported on the Nakata Eiichi pseudonym after Kuchibiru ni Uta o, written under that name, was selected for the Shogakukan Children's Publishing Culture Award. In 2010, he had also participated in Makai Tantei Meiosei O, a project in which eight writers concealed their identities and each wrote a book under the name Echizen Mataro.

Under his real name, Adachi Hirotaka has directed independent films. In 2004, Gōsuto wa Shōsetsuka ga Suki was selected for the 5th Takarazuka Film Festival and Video Contest, and he made four more works through around 2015.

In 2016, Otsuichi, Nakata Eiichi, Yamashiro Asako, and Echizen Mataro published the short-story collection Kill Mary Sue, with commentary by Adachi Hirotaka, bringing his major aliases together. He also revealed that he had contributed a film essay under the previously unknown alias Yuushi Pillow. The May 2016 issue of Da Vinci featured a discussion between his three principal aliases under the title "A Miraculous Talk Was Made."

His style has influenced authors such as Tomoi Hitsuji, who received recognition in the 2012 Kono Mystery ga Sugoi! rankings and has cited Otsuichi as a fan. He is also close friends with authors Sadakane Shinji and Matsubara Makoto; after traveling to Turkey with Adachi, the three co-wrote Toruko o Ryokō-shi.

Married to Oshii Tomoe, daughter of Oshii Mamoru. They had their first child in 2010.

Friends with Sadakane Shinji and Matsubara Makoto.

**Additional Sites:**
- [note](https://note.com/adachihirotaka)
- [SUZURI](https://suzuri.jp/HirotakaAdachi)

title.en: A Deal With My Fake Husband

altTitles.ja: 契約夫と共に甘い復讐を

description.en:
A curse has followed princess Elysia since the fall of her royal family. 

Without fail, each new husband of hers dies a year after their marriage. What was once thought to be a curse, however, is revealed to be Elysia's family who poisons her suitors in order to profit off of their inheritances. 

With their deplorable plans now brought to light, Elysia begins concocting her own vengeful schemes.

title.en: Does Spring Come for a Terminally-Ill Esper

description.pl: Iberis to esper klasy S, u którego zdiagnozowano nieuleczalną chorobę. Straciwszy rodzinę, kolegów i bliskich, niczego w życiu nie żałował. Gdyby miał jedno życzenie, byłoby to umrzeć z nieco mniejszym bólem. Jednak przewodnik klasy S Lucas nagle wkracza w życie Iberisa, sprawiając, że Iberis po raz drugi wątpi w to, czego naprawdę chce. Iberis, esper bez woli życia, i Lucas, przewodnik, który stara się go uratować. Jakie zakończenie czeka tych dwoje ludzi kroczących po krawędzi między życiem a śmiercią?

description.ar:
ما أرادته ماريان هو حياة هادئة وعاديةوا لكن ع مها انقلب فجأة بعد زواج و دتها من جديدوا لتجد نفسها أمام أخ غير شقيق… مزعج أكثر مما تحتمل!

“حتى يوم موتيوا لن أسمح لقطرة ماء بلمس يديك.”
“… ولماذا أنت مَن يَعِد بهذا؟”
“إن رغبتِ بشيءوا أخبريني في أي وقت.”
“إذنوا رجاءًوا توقف عن ملازمة منزل واذهب وابنِ صداقات بدلًا من ذلك!”

و مصيبة كبرى: إصراره على احترام كرهها للتميّز… بإنفاق ثروة فقط ليحوّل عربة فاخرة إلى عادية! فهل هو غريب أطوار؟ أم أن جميع نبلاء مجانين مثله؟

كانت ماريان تظن أن زواج و دتها مجرّد أمر يخصها وحدها… لكن آنوا هل تستطيع حقًا تقبّل هذه عائلة جديدة؟
description.en:
Marian, who longs to live a normal, quiet life, suddenly finds herself in a state of change. Her mother's remarriage has brought her a new brother, but the problem is... it's a burden!!

"Until the day I die, not a drop of water will touch your hands." 
"Why do you promise that?" 
"If you have any wishes, just tell me." 
"Please don't stay home and meet your friends outside and get to know them better." 

Even more, he's considerate of me, who hates to stand out, and he's even willing to spend money to change my fancy carriage into a more modest one. 

Is this person crazy? Or are all nobles this crazy? 

I thought my mother's remarriage was just her having a new husband, and it had nothing to do with me. But... can I accept my new family?
description.id: Marian, yang mengiginkan kehidupan normal dan tenang, tiba-tiba mendapati dirinya berada dalam situasi penuh perubahan. Pernikahan ulang ibunya membawakan seorang saudara laki-laki baru baginya, namun masalahnya… itu justru menjadi beban!! “Sampai hari di mana aku mati, setetes air pun tak akan menyentuh tanganmu.” “Kenapa kamu berjanji begitu?” “Kalau kamu punya keinginan, katakan saja padaku.” “Tolong jangan selalu di rumah. Temuilah teman-temanmu di luar dan cobalah bergaul dengan mereka.” Lebih dari itu, dia begitu perhatian padaku, yang benci menjadi pusat perhatian, bahkan sampai rela mengeluarkan uang untuk mengganti keretaku yang mewah menjadi yang lebih sederhana. Apakah orang ini gila? Atau memang semua bangsawan segila ini? Aku pikir pernikahan ulang ibuku hanya berarti dia mendapat suami baru, dan itu tidak ada hubungannya denganku. Tapi… apakah aku bisa menerima keluarga baruku?
description.ko:
평범하고 조용하게 살고 싶은 메리안의 환경이 난데없이 바뀌었다.
엄마의 재혼으로 새 오빠를 맞이하게 되었는데, 문제는…
부담스러워!!

“죽는 날까지, 네 손에 물방울 하나 묻히지 않겠다.”
“그걸 왜 님이 약속하세요?”

“바라는 것이 있으면 언제든 말해라.”
“제발 집에 있지 마시고 밖에서 친구들 만나 친목 좀 다지세요.”

심지어, 눈에 띄는 걸 싫어하는 나를 배려한다며,
화려한 마차를 억지로 수수하게 바꾸는 데까지 돈을 처바른다고?

이 사람이 이상한 걸까?
아니면, 귀족 사람들은 다 이렇게 미친 걸까?

엄마의 재혼은 엄마에게 새 남편이 생기는 것일 뿐,
자신과는 관계없는 일이라고 생각했는데,
나는… 새 가족을 받아들일 수 있을까?

description.en: Gi Rin Shin is a middle school girl who likes to observe the stars with a telescope. One day, while observing stars at night with her friends and relatives, she happened to encounter a cute boy and fell in love with him. The boy she encountered was Je Yeong Un, one of her distant relatives. Gi Rin's love is a relative!?

The cute new heiress of the Jo-Sun throne, Jung Gyuh-Woon! She ends up having two handsome bodyguards by her side! Through all her happiness from being escorted by the knights as the queen, the danger surrounding her slowly creeps closer. Knights, you have to protect the Queen!

Deep in the remote countryside, where the locals claim "a woman’s happiness lies in marriage," a suspiciously handsome man suddenly appears — the same one I recently found wandering near my vegetable patch.

And now, he’s introducing himself as my husband…

But every time...

Xu Min takes care of the family because her parents go to work early every morning. On the first day of high school, on a crowded train, she accidentally kisses the annoying and humourous Buay Fan. From then on, her normally peaceful life is disrupted…
A friendly, good-natured mailman traverses the rural areas of Korea on his red bicycle, dealing out letters and interacting with the letter-writers and recipients along the way.
description.fr: Empruntez les nombreux chemins de campagne à la rencontre des habitants de Yahwari (Corée du Sud). Vous croiserez sûrement cette bicyclette rouge, celle du facteur, qui circule doucement en harmonie avec la nature.

description.en: Grace lost her best friend in an accident back in high school. Years have passed, but she still suffers from deep depression and insomnia. She finally decides to face her greatest pain…

description.en:
After a life of neglect and a cold, loveless marriage to Duke Johann Leopold, Olivia Blanchett’s desperate attempts at love fail… until one day, Jian Han awakens in Olivia’s body. 

She seeks a divorce and flees to a rival kingdom, where she meets the charming but cunning Marquess Edgar Lancelot. Olivia is eager to start over and live her own life, all while her ex-husband secretly watches from afar. 

Will old flames be rekindled in this tale riddled with regret and revenge? Or will new love bloom?
description.ko:
언제나 자신의 사랑만을 갈구하던 여자,
올리비아 블란쳇이 이혼을 입에 올릴 때 요한은 조소했다.

이 무슨 고리타분한 수법이신지.

“지금… 뭐라고 했지?”
“이혼이요. 이혼해요, 우리.”

아내가 그레이트힐을 떠나갈 때까지만 해도 그는 믿지 않았다.
그녀의 사랑이 끝났다는 것을.
하지만 그에게 돌아온 건 올리비아의 사랑이 아닌 그녀와 에드가의 스캔들이었다.

요한 레오폴트가 무너졌다.

'말해줘, 올리비아.
어느 순간은 좋았던 적도 분명 있었다고.
내 곁에 있던 시간이 그리 외롭고 처절하지만은 않았다고.'

제발.

title.en: I Became the Empress Doomed to Die at the Hands of the Tyrant

altTitles.en: I Became the Empress Who Was Executed by the Tyrant
She Became the Empress Who Was Executed by the Tyrant

description.en:
A tyrant who kills his empress to wed another man. And that tyrant is my husband. ‘I’ have become ‘Mabel’, the ill-fated empress in a tragic Boys’ Love novel, destined for a miserable death. According to the original story, the tyrant, ‘Raven’, will soon meet his male lover, ‘Yunus’, and execute Mabel. Before that happens, I must divorce my tyrant husband, no matter what it takes! But then— 

“I’m sorry… I hope this eases your heart.” 

Why is he suddenly on the regretful male lead route?
description.ko:
남자와 결혼하겠다고 황후를 죽이는 폭군. 바로 내 남편 되시겠다. 

'나'는 비참한 죽음을 맞는 BL 소설 속의 황후 '메이벨'에 빙의하고 만다. 
원작대로라면 폭군 '레이븐'은 조만간 남자 애인인 '유누스'를 만나고 메이벨을 처형하게 될 것. 
그전에 폭군 남편과 무슨 수를 써서라도 이혼해야 한다…!! 

그런데─

description.en:
Ji-hun, a former member of a secret special forces unit under the Special Operations Planning Office of the South Korean Army Headquarters, returns from a long overseas deployment — only to receive the news that his younger sister Ji-yun has died, and that the person accused of killing her is none other than her boyfriend, Seo Min-jun.

While still struggling to accept the fact that his sister is gone, Ji-hun, who trusted Min-jun, learns that Min-jun was falsely accused and had gone to Yeokseon Prison in search of Ji-yun’s real killer.

But eventually, Min-jun also meets his death inside the prison.

Determined to uncover the truth behind the unjust deaths of both Ji-yun and Min-jun, Ji-hun becomes a prison guard and heads to Yeokseon Prison to uncover the secrets hidden within.

description.en:
Dongchan, who had lost his memory and had nowhere to go, was living with his grandmother, who ran a bookstore.

One day, the national mercenary group “Suradan” shattered his peaceful life by burning down the bookstore for an unjust reason. Enraged, Dongchan unintentionally unleashes the power of Asura.

Now pursued by Suradan, Dongchan leaves the village to uncover his true identity and seek revenge against Suradan.

기억을 잃어 갈 곳 없던 동찬은 서점을 운영하는 할머니와 함께 살고있었다.

어느 날, 국가 용병단 '수라단’이 부조리한 이유로 서점을 불태우며 평화롭던 일상을 산산조각내고, 이에 분노한 동찬은 의도치 않게 아수라의 힘을 발휘한다.

이후 수라단에게 쫓기는 신세가 된 동찬은 마을을 떠나 자신의 정체를 알기 위해, 또 수라단에게 복수하기 위해 여행을 떠나는데..!

description.en: Hana's a high school girl with a life that's only composed of one catastrophe after another. Her bad luck is only matched by her even worse temper and oversized ego. Tagging along are her best friend Sua and the poor victim Jiyong for some of the funniest misunderstandings and catastrophes.

description.fr: Won Do-yoon, a boy left alone in the most underdeveloped neighborhood. He was talented, but the world dragged him down. In a world where giant organizations grip and shake, we realize that the higher we go, the deeper we fall. Won Do-yoon finally chooses. The abyss instead of the top. And he stands at the center of the cartel himself and tries to bring down the huge organization.

Seung-ju est amoureux depuis longtemps de Jun-hyuk, le président du conseil étudiant. Mais un été, alors qu’il est tourmenté par cet amour impossible, quelqu’un surgit dans sa vie : Je-hyeon, le frère de Jun-hyuk. Confronté à ce nouvel intérêt pour lui, Seung-ju devra affronter ses sentiments et décider s’il pourra enfin se libérer de la fièvre de cet amour obsessionnel.

description.en: Branded a heartless and cruel sovereign, Emperor Herace of the Tevente Empire has lost three empresses to betrayal and murder. Into his life steps Eleanor Snow, the fearless daughter of House Snow, offering herself as his new empress to protect her family from ruin. In a world of assassins, treachery, and political unrest, their alliance is forged out of necessity but eventually tempered by trust. Together, they will fight to defend the empire… and each other.

description.en: From the outset, the plot seems to be the typical story of a half-angel, half-human boy with incredible powers (sealed in this case until his human form dies), but in the great Na Yeri style, intrigue and mysteries abound. Little Savian can see angels and devils; in fact, he can touch them and in some instances affect them in powerful ways. Low-rank angels Thunder and Panuel discover his ability as well as the devil Jarob who tries to break the seal on Savian, and for a moment, Savian becomes a golden-eyed nephilim… But then, his human form seals him back…?!

One day, Jin Yisu is ambushed by unknown assailants and loses his father, the only family he had. As time passes, he begins to realize that his father did not belong to the ordinary world.

When the assailants strike again and Jin’s life hangs in the balance, a group claiming to be his father’s former colleagues appears. Through them, Jin learns the identity of the attackers: the "Cheongdo" Group.

Cheongdo seeks to mobilize its operatives to illegally expand and redevelop corporate-run city districts, ultimately securing a political foothold. Upon discovering that his father and those former colleagues were covert agents resisting Cheongdo’s system and violence, Jin Yisu chooses to join their ranks.

Sometimes people say music can express one's feelings and emotions, it's true or not?

Suryeom is just an ordinary veterinarian... or is he? There's certainly more to Suryeom than meets the eye. What are his secrets? Where do his powers of perception come from? Who is his alter-ego, the Hound? And who is Argos? Whoever he is, there's only one man who could catch him, and he calls himself... Dr. Hound.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

What would you do if your neighbor didn't stop making noise? People think of Si-u Seo as a nice guy, but when his upstairs neighbor refuses to stop making noise, he gradually becomes consumed by his desire for revenge despite the fact that his neighbor is dangerous. Si-u will stop at nothing to ruin his neighbor's life, even if it means burning his own life to the ground.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)
Mizo gets elected as class rep and becomes involved in the lives of the class idol, Mario, and his girlfriend.

After her grandmother’s passing, Na Suhyeon returns to her hometown, leaving behind her city life.

Drawn by an inexplicable force, she climbs Obong Mountain—a place her grandmother had strictly forbidden her from entering while alive.

Lost deep in the woods and facing a mysterious danger, Suhyeon is rescued by a man named Seo Munju, who appears unharmed even after being beheaded.

Munju claims that Suhyeon is the reincarnation of Gang Yuhwa, his former spiritual mother and a shaman, and that the strange occurrences began when she set foot on the mountain.

Though wary of Munju, Suhyeon witnesses the chaos caused by vengeful spirits empowered by stolen sacred relics once buried in Gang Yuhwa’s grave. Moved by a sense of responsibility, she decides to help recover the five relics.

Munju suspects that the evil spirit who once drove Gang Yuhwa to her death is now reacting to Suhyeon’s aura and desecrated her grave.

Now, Suhyeon and Munju set out to confront tormented spirits and reclaim the relics.

Can they exorcise the evil spirit and end Munju’s eternal curse?

description.en:
“Did you come here to save me?”

It was a question so naïve it was almost laughable—yet within it lay her final hope. But the man, wearing an expression full of disgust, replied: “Of course not. I came here to drag you into hell.”

In his first life, Giscard Lodbrok cast Diana Brien into hell.

“You have to endure me. Just three years… that’s all. I won’t hold back for those three years. You’ll have to take all of my emotions.”

—I know.

That’s why I’m doing this now.

Diana nodded dryly, while the man lowered his head, whispering brokenly into her embrace, “Damn it… Then why did you abandon me?”

In his second life, Giscard Lodbrok fell into hell because of Diana Brien.
description.ko:
“나를 구해주러 온 거니?”

가증스러울 정도의 순진한 물음이었으나, 거기엔 마지막 희망이 담겨있었다.
그러나, 남자는 혐오스럽다는 표정을 지으며 말했다.

“설마요.”
“…….”
“당신을 지옥으로 빠트리기 위해 온 겁니다.”

첫 번째 생, 기스카르 로드브로크는 다이애나 브리엔을 지옥으로 빠트렸다.

***

“당신은 나를 견뎌야 해.”
“…….”
“겨우, 겨우 3년이라고…….”
“…….”
“난 그 3년 동안, 참지 않을 거야. 내 모든 감정을 받아줘야 해.”
“…….”

알고 있어. 그래서 지금 이 짓을 하는 거잖아. 다이애나가 건조하게 고개를 끄덕였다.
남자가 고개를 숙이며 그녀의 품에 흐느끼듯 낮게 속삭였다.

“제기랄, 그러니 나를 왜 버렸어…….”

두 번째 생, 기스카르 로드브로크는 다이애나 브리엔 때문에 지옥에 빠졌다.
description.ru:
– Ты пришёл спасти меня?

Невероятно наивный и почти что смешной вопрос, в котором чувствовалась её последняя надежда.

Мужчина, с отвращением на лице, ответил:

– Конечно, нет.

– …

– Я прибыл сюда, чтобы низвергнуть тебя в ад.

В первой жизни Гискард Лодброк превратил жизнь Дианы Бриенн в ад.

– Тебе придётся терпеть меня.

– …

– Всего лишь три года…

– …

– Я не буду сдерживаться всё это время. Тебе придется прочувствовать всё то, что чувствовал я.

– …

– Знаю, поэтому и соглашаюсь.

Диана коротко кивнула, пока мужчина, опустив голову, сломано шептал ей:

– Чёрт… Почему ты бросила меня?

Во второй жизни Гискард Лодброк сам оказался в аду из-за Дианы Бриенн.

description.en:
Alissa, the librarian at the Royal Library, one day discovers a diary that has a special magic. After she writes her name in the diary, she meets a boy in an unfamiliar place who introduces himself as Louis. 

Alissa, who thought she was just a world in a diary anyway, becomes friends with young Louis and she spends her time with him. Meanwhile, the young king who did not get married put the whole country in trouble. To finally select a queen, unmarried noble women from all over the country are invited to a ball. 

However, at the ball that Alissa nonchalantly attended, confident that nothing would happen, the king strangely took an interest in her.

description.pt-br:
"Devo simplesmente devorá-lo?"

Orca Ware, o jovem mestre da família Ware — um clã de metamorfos Orca — retorna de um campo de batalha banhado em sangue. Para um homem que prefere a carnificina à paz e encontra conforto na guerra em vez do luxo, a Mansão Orca é simplesmente de um tédio insuportável.

Então, um servo patético e tolo chamado Nia aparece diante dele. Atormentado pelos outros funcionários por ser um metamorfo Peixe Dourado, Nia está secretamente saciando sua fome no lago da propriedade tarde da noite... quando dá de cara com Orca.

"Jovem Mestre, eu estava errado... Por favor, eu imploro, me poupe..."

Ele é mais fraco e patético do que qualquer um, mas sua luta para sobreviver... é absolutamente irritante.

Orca tenta ignorar, mas seu olhar continua voltando para o pequeno e frágil Nia. A mansão, antes definida por seu tédio, agora está preenchida com um tremor inexplicável.

'그 누구도 사랑하지 않을 거야'
'그 누구도 믿지 않을 거야.'

아버지의 잦은 사업 실패는 지아를 생활고에 시달리게 했고,
6년 사귄 남자친구의 바람은 지아를 죽음에 이르게 했다.

'다음 생이 있다면...'

그렇게 끝인 줄 알았다. 그런데...

"메이린, 일어났어? 이제 좀 괜찮니?"

오랜 내전으로 인해 헬라이튼 국에서 페링턴 국으로 넘어온
피난민 여자아이 '메이린'으로 환생하게 된다.
과연 메이린이 된 지아는 이번 생에는 부자가 되어
내 집 마련의 꿈을 이룰 수 있을 것인가?

description.en: Bailey Yang is boyfriend hunting. Only problem? She's an antisocial recluse with a shallow definition of love. Things are looking hopeless for her until she discovers she has a secret admirer.

description.id: Menjelang festival sekolah, Han So-eun mendapat tugas mempersiapkan pameran foto. Setelah bertemu secara tak sengaja dengan seorang pemuda bernama Yoon Ji-hoo dan mulai memotret bersamanya, kehidupan sehari-hari yang awalnya biasa perlahan menjadi istimewa. Namun, ada sebuah rahasia yang tersembunyi. Di usia delapan belas tahun yang paling gemilang, inilah kisah tentang cinta pertama dan perjalanan kita menuju kedewasaan.

description.en:
Hee-Yul Yoon has just moved back from America to Korea with her sister, Suh Hee Yoon. She is determined to deal with her hard past by leaving behind her aunt, uncle and her friend Ricky Ha. After buying a pack of cigarettes she bumps into a handsome boy. And then all of a sudden he kisses her! Who is this annoying bastard and what's his deal?! You had better believe that our heroine Hee-Yul will get to the bottom of this!

description.en:
Since birth, bananas are always with Nana because her family is running a banana business. Even her name has "banana" in it.  
Nana is forced to transfer schools…and it happens that her her new school is named "Banana". There, Nana meets a tall and beautiful "girl" who always treats her nicely. To Nana's suprise, this "girl" is actually a guy….?!!!

Disapproved by his parents, Eunjun now lives apart from his family for the first time in his life.  
Somehow electric appliances don't work as they should when Eunjun lays his hands on them.  
Fortunately, there's an old electrical repair shop nearby where he became a regular.  
Jihu comes to help his father and notices Eunjun spending more time at the shop than he needs to.

Richard asks the street painter Pascal for a portrait on the spot. As soon as he sat down on a chair and took off his hat, Pascal ran away. The word he uttered while being caught was 'Richard'. Richard invites Pascal to his house, and the story of Pascal moving back and forth between the past and the present in a mansion full of beautiful art begins...

Ritz: The doll scientist.   
Darlene: The doll created by Ritz…   
Ritz begins teaching of the world, humanity, and how to become human to Darlene, whose existence revolves around his own, Ritz, but…

title.en: The King of Fighters: R's Letter

altTitles.ko: 더 킹 오브 파이터즈 R 의 편지

description.en: As the ordinary owner of a toy workshop, Tria spent her days struggling to pay off a mountain of debt with the help of Shadie, her trusty shadow friend. Luckily for her, a mysterious, half-dead client shows up one day, offering a jaw-dropping amount of money to make an expensive toy. Despite being wary of the man and his circumstances, Tria accepts the commission. But it doesn't take long for her to realize that this dictatorial client is just one of the many tyrants that will plague her shop...

Haeyoon Suh is a scrappy, cute 18-year-old who's attached at the hip to the slick Sungmoo Kang. Sungmoo, the easygoing, compassionate and carefree best friend of Haeyoon's brother, Haeil, has always been the person Haeyoon turns to. For everything. Ever since they were children, Sungmoo's been there to comfort Haeyoon when Haeil goes into overdrive with the discipline, but as the years wore on, the three boys have grown apart. With Sungmoo trying to keep the conflicted Haeyoon at arm's length, Haeyoon can't help but feel his heart breaking. Just when things couldn't get worse, Wooje Kim, the school bad-ass, has set his sights on Haeyoon…
The dog I was raising turned into a human…?! A story of metamorphosis.

title.en: Night Has Come, Android, Please Raise Your Head

altTitles.en: It's Night, Android, Please Raise Your Head

description.en:
New work by Han Kuenbit, the author of POLAR NIGHT and POLAR NIGHT 2: PONTUS!

In an era when fists were closer than the law, markets at that time were battlegrounds where only the strong survived. Noryangjin Fish Market VS Majang Meat Market, a fierce battle passed down among the market merchants’ associations, is about to begin.
A tale surrounding the mystical power known as “the Cabal” takes three adventurers on a journey to become Cabalists.

title.en: Can Love Blossom in a Poisoned Heart?

description.en:
As a child, Prince Paris Vladimiro rescued Sasha Corsico from a beast, in exchange for her oath to stand by his side. But to truly save Sasha's life, her family turned to sorcery, transforming her into a vampire. 

Prince Paris also bears a curse: toxic blood that has already killed four would-be brides... but not Sasha. A decade after they first met, Sasha and Paris are forced into a marriage meant to destroy them both. 

Can they overcome this fate and learn to love the monsters they've become?
Every night at 10 o'clock, the story of their love goes on the radio. DJ Hee-ra's love letter. Starts now.

Karam's new teacher, Mr. Lee, is also her mother's new boarder. Why does he seem so interested in Karam, and why does she feel some strange connection to him? This is a story of past and present lives, love, jealousy, sacrifice, and salvation.

altTitles.en: Baby Dragon to the Duke's Rescue
The Baby Dragon Saves the Duke Family

description.de: Nach dem Verlust ihres heiligen Tieres droht dem Haus Moonreppe der Untergang – denn was ist das Haus eines Herzogs ohne sein göttliches heiliges Tier? Um die Familie zu retten, beschließt der junge Herzog Edenver Moonreppe, ein neues heiliges Tier zu beschwören, doch muss verdutzt feststellen, dass er es statt mit einem mächtigen Monster mit einem niedlichen Babydrachen zu tun hat. Der kleine Drache namens Acille ist mindestens genauso verwirrt – vor allem weil Edenver laut ihrer Mutter ihr zukünftiger Ehemann sein soll! Hatte ihre Mutter damit Recht? Und werden Acille und ihr vermeintlicher zukünftiger Ehemann das Haus Monreppe retten können?
description.en:
After the loss of its divine beast, House Moonreppe is on the verge of collapse. Desperate to save his household, the young Duke Edenver Moonreppe decides to summon a legendary beast to become their new divine beast. He’s prepared to take on whatever monster that is summoned, only to meet baby dragon Acille.

Edenver is not sure such a small creature could be their new divine beast… until he discovers that this baby dragon packs quite the punch in terms of both power and loveability.

Will Acille change Edenver’s life for the better in more ways than one?
description.fr: Après la perte de sa bête divine, la Maison Moonreppe vacille au bord du gouffre. Déterminé à sauver sa famille, le jeune duc Edenver Moonreppe entreprend alors d’invoquer une créature légendaire pour en faire leur nouvelle bête divine. Prêt à affronter les monstres les plus redoutables, il ne s’attend pourtant pas à rencontrer… une petite dragonne nommée Acille. D’abord sceptique face à une créature si minuscule, Edenver découvre bientôt qu’Acille est aussi redoutablement puissante que terriblement attachante. Et si cette petite dragonne était la clé du salut et du bonheur d’Edenver?
description.ko:
신수가 존재하는 '알리오페 제국'을 대표하는 4대 공작가 중
모종의 이유로 신수의 분노를 사게되어 잃게 된 문레페 공작가.

어린 공작 '에든베르'는 망해가는 가문을 살리고자
신수를 대신할 고대 생물 소환을 하게 되는데…

어떤 괴물이 소환되더라도 반드시 굴복시켜 신수로 세울 것이라는
비장한 다짐과는 다르게 막상 소환된 생물은―

"삐-야!"
머리에 알껍질조차 떼지 못한 작고 하찮은 아기용이었다?!

게다가 통역 마법을 걸자마자 그에게 건넨 첫마디가
"삐얏…삐야삐…(남편아…아실이 맛없어…)" 라니…

과연 에든베르는 다짜고짜 자신을 남편이라고 부르는
아기용 '아실'을 신수로 삼아 공작가를 살릴 수 있을까?
description.ru:
Среди четырёх великих герцогств «Империи Алиопы», где обитают божественные звери, находится Дом Мунлефе, который потерял свою Божественный зверь, навлекший на себя его гнев по неизвестным причинам.

Молодой герцог Эденвер, отчаянно пытаясь спасти свою увядающую семью, призывает древнее существо, чтобы оно заняло его место…

Он был твёрдо намерен подчинить себе любого появившегося монстра и сделать его своим новым божественным зверем, но существо, откликнувшееся на его призыв, оказалось…

«Пп-ии!»

Маленьким, невзрачным дракончиком, который даже не сбросил скорлупу с головы?!

Более того, первые слова, которые он произнес после того, как он наложил заклинание перевода, были:

«Ппии… Пи-япи… (Муж… Асиль невкусный…)»

Сможет ли Эденвер действительно спасти своё герцогство, превратив этого дракончика «Асиля», который с самого начала называет его «мужем», в своего божественного зверя?
«Ппии… Пи-япи… (Муж… Асиль невкусный…)»

Суждено ли Эденверу спасти свое герцогство, обуздав этого крошечного «Асиля», что с первых мгновений нарекает его «мужем», и превратить в божественного зверя?

description.fr:
Au moment où elle est séparée de sa famille bien-aimée, la chatte Haru se retrouve transportée dans son enfance, avant son adoption.
Pour retrouver sa maman, Sowon, qui ne la connaît pas encore, elle se met en route vers la maison de ses souvenirs, mais pour cette petite chatte qui ne comprend ni la langue des humains ni les chemins, le monde est bien trop vaste et hostile.
Haru pourra-t-elle retrouver sa famille ? - projet par la rémos
description.ko:
사랑하는 가족과 이별한 순간, 고양이 하루는 입양되기 전 어린 시절로 돌아온다.
자신을 아직 모르는 엄마 소원을 다시 만나기 위해 기억 속 집을 향해 길을 나서지만, 사람의 말도 길도 알 수 없는 작은 고양이에게 세상은 너무 넓고 험하다.
하루는 다시 가족이 될 수 있을까?

description.en:
Dongsoo is parted with his lover after he witnesses her having a one-night stand with Inhan.  
To his surprise and dismay, the new laywer hired to his company happened to be Inhan, and they can't avoid running into each other at work.  
As a revenge for ruining his love life, Dongsoo seduces Inhan's partners and somehow succeeds each time.  
Inhan finds Dongsoo annoying, but somehow interesting in a way.
"Dear children, open the exit in the name of despair!"

What if marriage was just a business deal? Park Minho, the heir to one of Korea's largest corporations, thinks it might be the way to please his ever-discontent father. No messy feelings, no one gets hurt. To his surprise, he stumbles upon Lee Jinyoung. She might not have the conventional credentials or looks of his other potential matches, but she's on the same page about marriage. Scarred by her own past and too busy for love, Jinyoung agrees to play the part of the perfect wife and daughter-in-law in exchange for financial support. After sealing the deal on their contract, the question lingers: can their "love" story ever turn into something more?

One day, a penguin, thought to live only in Antarctica, broke into the home of nerdy Mr. Gong!
The only word it could say was "Kuku," and it supposedly came from Africa!
Mr. Gong ends up living with Kuku, who wants to transform Korea into a place as relaxing and romantic as its home, Boulders Beach.
A hard K-life awaits the two of them!

description.en: When the orphaned Sera was taken in by the Lady of the Choi household, her dreams of having a family were fulfilled. However, Sera found herself rejected by the Lady's three handsome sons, and it was made very clear to her that she was nothing more than an orphan who would would never become part of their family. At 16, Sera still finds herself bullied by the three brothers, and soon it becomes evident that there is more than just her background that makes the boys reluctant to officially adopt her into the family.

When college student Hera Kang agrees to carry out her professor’s errand, she has no idea that her professor is actually a centuries-old deity. 

And the errand in question? Hera must choose between a shapeshifting fox and snake, deciding which one of them will receive the amulet in her possession to become a god.

Tian and Drei von Richenstein, two unlikely heroes, embark on an adventure filled with excitement, intrigue, and comic relief. Their adventures are complicated by the fact that they have a knack for making allies into new enemies…
